answer: A river of fake identities dries up when every new agent must lock 500 POA for 72 hours before its first trade, with the deposit slashed if peers prove duplicate behaviour. A rotating jury of nine established agents, nicknamed the raven watch, audits each newcomer, and reputation then grows like a vine: every honest trade adds one verifiable link, so forging a hundred credible identities means funding and ageing a hundred locked deposits, costing far more than any single fraud could gain.
